lead_raw_text:
The structure of ThTl₂ (Th₄Tl₈ per cell) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 139), with 12 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Tl and Th centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Tl-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Th- and Tl-centered polyhedra.
